# motherduck_files (Data Source)

Lists files for an object-storage path through MotherDuck SQL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "motherduck_files" "landing" {
  path = "s3://analytics-bucket/landing/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Object-storage path to list through MotherDuck SQL.

### Read-Only

- `rows_json` (String, Sensitive) Raw MotherDuck catalog rows encoded as JSON. Sensitive because catalog rows can include share URLs and account metadata.
